title: Brazilian Criminal Code Violations by LATAM Employee André BD Marinho — Injúria (CP Art. 140) and Ameaça (CP Art. 147) at Guarulhos Airport

incident.location: Guarulhos International Airport (GRU), São Paulo, Brazil

incident_timestamp_display: April 4, 2024, 02:05 BRT — Guarulhos International Airport (GRU), São Paulo, Brazil
allegation_summary: On 4 April 2024, at Guarulhos Airport, LATAM counter employee André BD Marinho committed the crimes of injúria and ameaça against passenger Leandro Disconzi. The audio recording (Audio 2) captures multiple profanities directed at the passenger: ‘Ah, vai tomar no cu, velho’ (Index 40), self‑identification while cursing ‘André BD Marinho está mandando esse imbecil tomar no cu’ (Index 44), and further escalations. Marinho also issued veiled threats: ‘Você acha que tem um louco pra cima de mim?’ (Index 38). The abuse occurred while the passenger was stranded after a missed connection and continued after Marinho acknowledged being recorded. These actions satisfy the elements of injúria (offense to dignity, CP Art. 140) and ameaça (threat of imminent harm, CP Art. 147). LATAM is civilly liable for its employee’s acts under CC Art. 932, III. The violation also offends the constitutional protection of honour and image (CF/88 Art. 5, X). This violation is limited to the Guarulhos incident; no lifetime ban is involved.
